findings.description: Wendel Weichel's mother was Josefine Weichel/Weishel, born about 1892 in Russia; his father was Jacob Weichel/Weishel, born about 1890 in Russia. The family immigrated to Canada in 1924 and was enumerated at Weyburn No. 67, Saskatchewan in 1926.
supporting_sources: Canada, Prairie Provinces, Census, 1926 — household of Jacob Weishel and Josefine Weishel, Weyburn No. 67, Saskatchewan

findings.description: Wendel Weichel had siblings Peter (b. 1919, Russia), Augina (b. 1922, Germany), Katherina (b. 1923, Germany) and Barbara (b. 1925, Saskatchewan).

target_person.name: Peter, Augina, Katherina and Barbara Weichel

supporting_sources: Canada, Prairie Provinces, Census, 1926 — household of Jacob Weishel and Josefine Weishel
